title: Topological Dynamics Under Non-Stationary Supervision: Persistent Homology of Neural Network Weight Evolution
abstract: arXiv:2611.13701v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We investigate how the persistent topology of neuron- weight point clouds evolves under stable and non-stationary supervision. An identical multilayer perceptron is trained on Fashion-MNIST with correct labels, a fixed random permutation of the training-label vector, or a fresh permutation every epoch. Five paired seeds share initialisation and minibatch order, yielding 15 models trained for 100 epochs. Raw and row-normalised incoming weight clouds are analysed with H0 and H1 Vietoris Rips persistence at 22 checkpoints. Correct-label models reach 89.39% mean true-label test accuracy; fixed-random models fit 67.94% of their assigned training targets without generalising to the original task. Correct-label models have descriptively greater time-averaged normalised fc3 H1 persistence than either random-label condition, but the configured exact comparisons do not reach conventional significance after Holm correction. translated_title: 非平稳监督下的拓扑动力学：神经网络权重演化的持续同调
translated_abstract: 我们研究了在稳定与非平稳监督下，神经元权重点云的持续拓扑如何演化。我们在Fashion-MNIST数据集上训练了结构完全相同的多层感知器，分别采用正确标签、训练标签向量的固定随机置换、或每个epoch重新生成的新随机置换。五个配对随机种子共享相同的初始化和小批量顺序，共得到15个训练100个epoch的模型。在22个检查点处，对原始及按行归一化的输入权重点云进行了H0和H1 Vietoris-Rips持续性分析。正确标签模型的平均真实标签测试准确率达到89.39%；固定随机标签模型拟合了其被分配训练目标的67.94%，但无法泛化到原始任务。正确标签模型的时间平均归一化fc3层H1持续性在描述性上高于两种随机标签条件，但经过Holm校正后，预设的精确比较并未达到常规显著性水平。早期条件分类……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本研究利用持续同调追踪不同标签监督条件下神经网络权重点云的拓扑演化，发现正确标签模型的H1持续性在描述性上高于随机标签条件，但经多重检验校正后未达统计显著性。
